lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like spatial arrangement of high-luminance circular spots organized into four primary vertical columns posterior to the gill slits on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form localized anchor nodes across the visible lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal ridge feature on the upper-lateral flank characterized by a high-to-low vertical luminance gradient.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal Echeneidae attached to the ventral-lateral surface and a single high-chroma yellow teleost (pilot fish) located near the pectoral fin insertion point.
